reviews.review: great game and fun to play with friends and lots of builds for the skills for each hero.

Incredibly solid roguelite looter-shooter. Fans of Borderlands should definitely give it a shot. Seasonal content is great, zero weird monetization or FOMO mechanics. All around fantastic game with devs who deserve high praise. Only issue I have is that their English localization is sometimes not great, so it can be difficult to tell what certain mechanics do from reading the tooltips, but that doesn't detract from the excellent gameplay IMO, just something to be aware of.

Entertainment: 35/40
An incredibly simple but well made FPS rouge-light.

Design: 16/20
 + Shooting is very well made, with several sub-mechanics to make weapons and builds feel different.
 + Each character has been given a very unique play style and set of skills to accent it. 
 + The prefix system is really neat and are a lot more interesting then they typically are in other games.
 - A few bosses feel rather unfair, using new and exclusive mechanics that can put a god run in the ground.
 - The game is very easy. You can get so many damage multipliers running at the same time that by the mid-game you can reliable one shot anything.
 - This game has a very potent meta progression. Much too potent in some situations as some characters receive massive boosts.
 - With the way that the randomized systems work in this game, runs end up feelin rather bottle necked and samey by what character you play as.

Presentation: 14/20
 + The art style is simple and fun.
 + Characters are incredibly cute in a psuedo-chibi style. 
 + Weapons are all given a distinct look from one another and other games as well. 
 + Uses Chinese myth and culture in a really fun way in location, character, and enemy design.
 - Music isn't great. It is far from bad, but It falls within the ambiance type of OST. Something that plays in the background while you listen to a podcast or video essay.

Story: 9/20
 - I think there's a story, but it doesn't really matter in games like this.

Final Statement: 73/100
Very fun game that I will gladly play more of, but it isn't interesting enough to be THE game, if you get what I mean.
